6 /-! Actual radial triangle charts for small polyhedra with a cofacial source.
7 The construction proves surface coverage, flat junction compatibility,
8 original-vertex leaves, and consistent frames across every tree edge.
9 It precedes the separate source-angle budget and global nonoverlap proof. -/
10 
11 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
12 
13 open Set
14 
15 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
16   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
17     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
18 
19 include size small_faces in
20 /-- For a cofacial source, construct the entire chart collection and its common frames. -/
21 theorem small_exists_cut_tree_charts (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
22     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
23     Nonempty (CutTreeCharts T) := by
24   classical
25   let fan (u : T.vertices) (nonvertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :=
26     Classical.choice (small_exists_junction_fan size small_faces a T u nonvertex)
27   let triangles {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) : PlacedCutEdgeTriangles T edge :=
28     if original : (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices then
29       ⟨Classical.choice (small_exists_cut_edge_triangles size small_faces a T edge), AffineIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ Plane⟩
30     else ((fan u original).edgeTriangles edge).placed
31   obtain ⟨frames⟩ := exists_cut_tree_frames T @triangles
32   refine ⟨{
33     fan := fan
34     triangles := @triangles
35     at_fan := ?_
36     original_leaves := fun u original =>
37       small_cofacial_source_original_is_leaf size small_faces a T cofacial u original
38     frames := frames
39     covers := ?_ }⟩
40   · intro u v edge nonvertex
41     simp only [triangles, dif_neg nonvertex]
42   · intro b
43     obtain ⟨d, member⟩ := small_cut_tree_triangles_cover size small_faces a T
44       (fun d => (triangles d.adj).toCutEdgeTriangles) b
45     exact ⟨d.fst, d.snd, d.adj, member⟩
46 
47 include size small_faces in
48 /-- A universal source supplies all the geometric charts of the star construction. -/
49 theorem small_universal_source_cut_tree_charts
50     (a : frontier P.body) (source : P.Vertex) (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space))
51     (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v)
52     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) : Nonempty (CutTreeCharts T) :=
53   small_exists_cut_tree_charts size small_faces a T
54     (universal_source_cofacial a source at_source universal)
55 
56 include size small_faces in
57 /-- Construct both the actual cut tree and its complete chart collection at a universal source. -/
58 theorem small_exists_universal_star_charts
59     (a : frontier P.body) (source : P.Vertex) (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space))
60     (universal : ∀ v : P.Vertex, v ≠ source → P.edgeGraph.Adj source v) :
61     ∃ T : P.CutLocusTree a, Nonempty (CutTreeCharts T) := by
62   obtain ⟨T⟩ := small_exists_regular_cut_tree size small_faces a
63   exact ⟨T, small_universal_source_cut_tree_charts size small_faces a source at_source universal T⟩
64 
65 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
